name: Engineering Academy
org: University of Washington College of Engineering
what_you_do: A free one week summer program at UW Seattle for teens new to engineering. Students do hands-on design tasks, meet engineering students and teachers, and tour campus.
grades: 10 or 11 (during the school year before the summer)
who_can_apply: Any Washington state high school sophomore or junior in the 2025-2026 school year can apply. You need no engineering experience. You get yourself to and from the UW Seattle campus.
duration: 1 week, Monday to Friday, 10 am to 4 pm (2026: July 20 to 24)
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. The page says the 2027 application will open in March.
how_to_apply: Apply online when it opens in March 2027.
notes: Free of cost to participants. The page is an introductory program for students curious about engineering. Work permit rule not stated.
